text:
IncBot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate detected across api-gateway-eu-west. Error codes leaning Bad Gateway / Upstream Timeout. P95 latency up. Auto-pager triggered.
Sara (oncall): saw it. I'm on it. starting quick blast checklist.
Mike (SRE): looking at edge proxy metrics — connection errors spiking on the mux layer, upstream timeouts to the inference cluster.
Jess (runtime): any recent rollouts? I don't see a model or runtime deploy in the last 30m.
Kevin (infra): no infra deploys either. Network egress increased suddenly from a handful of customers.
Olivia (support): Customer-impact: 3 large customers reporting failed requests in EU region via support tickets. Marking priority P1.
Sara (oncall): ok first mitigation: enable circuit-break on gateway pool 7 and throttle heavy clients. Mike can you flip a soft limit on client throttles?
Mike (SRE): doing now. Pushing rate-limit config to mux pool 7: `limit=120rps per api-key` for suspected keys. applying in 10s.
Mike (SRE): applied. Observability note: watch `gateway.mux.errors` and `upstream.timeout.count`.
Jess (runtime): enabling short-term routing fallback to model-compact variant for non-critical routes to reduce upstream load. Rolling 3 workers to fallback.
Kevin (infra): spinning up 4 extra gateway instances (eu-west-burst) to absorb burst. ETA ~45s.
Sara (oncall): good. also pause non-essential background jobs that make external calls from EU region (batch-embed sync). Jess, can you gate those?
Jess (runtime): paused batch job queue `embed-sync-eu` via console.
Olivia (support): informing affected customers that we're mitigating and will follow up when stable.
Mike (SRE): telemetry: `gateway.mux.errors` down 28% after throttles, `upstream.timeout.count` trending down. P95 latency starting to fall.
Sara (oncall): keep throttles on while we stabilize, then we'll gradually relax. What's root cause hypothesis?
Kevin (infra): likely a combination of a noisy client and a sudden downstream slowdown in inference pool (cold restart on some nodes). The noisy clients caused queue buildup and upstream timeouts.
Jess (runtime): corroborating: some inference workers showed higher GC pauses and restarted ~2m ago. We're collecting GC logs and core dumps.
Mike (SRE): next steps: leave throttles for 15m, keep fallback routing active, keep infra scale for 5m, then reassess. If timeouts return, we'll circuit the problematic upstream and failfast to secondary region.
Sara (oncall): agreed. I'll own postmortem and timeline. Olivia, please capture customer tickets and send a brief update to affected customers with timeframe.
Olivia (support): on it. Drafting message: "We experienced elevated errors in EU region affecting requests between 12:12-12:25 UTC. Mitigations applied; service returning to normal. We'll follow with RCA"
IncBot: Note: incident channel created: #incident-1761357924. Please add timeline entries.
Mike (SRE): monitoring: error-rate stabilized to baseline in last 2m. Removing emergency throttles in a staged fashion: decreasing limit to 300rps then full removal in 5m.
Kevin (infra): gateway instances will scale down automatically.
Jess (runtime): collecting logs for RCA; tagging trace ids for a sample window.
Sara (oncall): closing active mitigation window. We'll keep this thread open for the RCA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Olivia (support): customers updated. closing loop with support team.
